name: vnkc/source-registry
description: The VNKC candidate source registry itself, published as a dataset: 36 official Vietnamese sources across law, tax, labour, statistics, and administrative domains, tiered and license-audited.

license_manifest.attribution: Bộ Tư pháp nước CHXHCN Việt Nam — vbpl.vn
Cục Thông tin, Truyền thông / Văn phòng Chính phủ — ghi rõ nguồn www.chinhphu.vn

known_limitations: Checksum is an all-zeros placeholder — real content checksums are computed by the release pipeline, which does not exist yet (Phase 0).
license_manifest is an excerpt (2 of 36 sources) for illustration; a real release enumerates every source.
License statuses are desk-research findings, not legal advice; see DATA_LICENSES.md.
intended_uses: Discovering authoritative Vietnamese data sources with provenance and licensing posture
Planning ingestion pipelines for the canonical knowledge layer
prohibited_uses: Legal advice or any representation that registry metadata is legally authoritative
Redistributing source content under a license broader than its license_status permits
